title: BPS vortex from nonpolynomial scalar QED in a $\mathds{C}\mathrm{P}^1$-Maxwell theory
summary: We investigate a generalized gauged $\mathds{C}\mathrm{P}^1$-Maxwell theory in which the electromagnetic sector acquires a field-dependent magnetic permeability generated dynamically through fermionic vacuum polarization.
